title: Closure of log space under reductions
statement: Let $B$ and $C$ be languages of finite binary words. If $B$ is log-space reducible to $C$ and $C$ is decidable in space bounded by a constant multiple of $\log_2(n)+1$, then $B$ is also decidable in space bounded by a constant multiple of $\log_2(n)+1$.
hypotheses_covered: B and C are languages of binary words
B is log-space reducible to C
